lines.text: A rich man's manager is accused of wasting his possessions, so the rich man tells him to turn in an account.
The manager, too weak to dig and too ashamed to beg, plans so people will welcome him into their homes.
The manager tells the debtor owing a hundred measures of barley to write fifty, and another to write eighty.
The master commends the dishonest manager for acting shrewdly, and Jesus says to use worldly wealth to make friends.
Jesus says faithfulness with little means faithfulness with much, and no one can serve both God and Baal.
